name: foam-lsp
description: Autocomplete, hover, go-to-definition, and diagnostics for FOAM3 model files

foam.buildScript.description: Path to build.sh relative to workspace root

foam.nodePath.description: Absolute path to the Node binary that launches the language server. Leave empty to use the Node bundled with VS Code — this avoids 'spawn node ENOENT' when VS Code is launched from the GUI without a shell PATH (e.g. Node installed via nvm).

foam.features.diagnostics.java.description: Diagnostics for Java import/code block errors. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.diagnostics.i18n.description: Diagnostics for hardcoded display strings passed to .add(). Missing translations are a separate flag: foam.features.hints.i18nMissingLanguage. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.hints.i18nMissingLanguage.description: Offers to machine-translate: hint diagnostics, quick fixes, and the CodeLens for message: entries missing a configured target language. Turning this off withdraws all three. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.completion.description: Autocomplete. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.hover.description: Hover documentation for classes, properties, and methods. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.semanticTokens.description: Semantic highlighting for resolved class references and typed variables. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.signatureHelp.description: Parameter hints inside method call parentheses. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.folding.description: Code folding for properties:/methods:/requires:/etc. arrays. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.codeLens.i18n.description: CodeLens naming how many translations a messages: entry is missing. Also requires foam.features.hints.i18nMissingLanguage, since clicking the lens translates. Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.features.codeLens.hierarchy.description: CodeLens annotations for class hierarchy (subclass/implementor counts). Takes effect after a server restart.

foam.i18n.languages.description: Target language codes for i18n translation. Empty: derive from every distinct locale in journals/locales.jrl.

foam.i18n.endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint for i18n translation (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM). Empty: fall back to the OLLAMA_HOST environment variable.

foam.i18n.model.description: Model name to request from the i18n translation endpoint. Empty: fall back to the OLLAMA_TRANSLATION_MODEL environment variable.

foam.i18n.sourceLanguage.description: Language the bare message: value is written in.
